title_or_description: Notice of Termination of Collective Bargaining Agreement (to AFGE and NVAC #53)
what_it_says: Terminates the August 8, 2023 VA-AFGE Master CBA plus local supplements/MOUs effective Mar 26 2026 for all employees covered by EO 14251 (police, firefighters, security guards excepted). Also states VA terminated all CBAs with national unions Aug 6 2025 and with local unions effective Nov 13 2025 (exempted employees excepted), and that the Apr 17 2025 suspension order was rescinded Nov 13 2025.

title_or_description: DFAS Director, Human Resources (Andrew Hartz)
source_type: Notice of Exclusion from Representation in Accordance with EO 14251
url: agency document posted on a House member's site (mannion.house.gov)
retrieved: 'all collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) between the American Federation of Government Employees, AFL-CIO (AFGE) and U.S. Department of Defense, Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS), are hereby terminated'; excludes EO-exempt employees, the 90 FR 17052 population, and units covered by a court order. (Memo heading says 'American Association of Government Employees'; body says AFGE.)

title_or_description: Termination of Certain Collective Bargaining Agreements in Accordance with EO 14251 (memo; DoD public notice posted 2026-04-22)
source_type: primary agency document - NOT RETRIEVED (media.defense.gov returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch); content known from GovExec 2026-04-16 and the DFAS memo
what_it_says: Per GovExec (Erich Wagner, 2026-04-16, https://www.govexec.com/workforce/2026/04/hegseth-orders-termination-union-contracts/412899/): directs 'the termination of all collective bargaining agreements to which the department is a party' within 24 hours, except agreements subject to a court order enjoining EO 14251, the population covered by the Apr 2025 SecDef certification, and 'the local employing offices of any agency police officers, security guards or firefighters'.

title_or_description: Memo rescinding and replacing the Apr 9 2026 memo; components to terminate or re-terminate on or about Aug 31 2026
source_type: secondary only (Federal Workers Legal Defense Network newsletter 2026-09-02); primary not found
what_it_says: Newsletter: memo 'rescinds and replaces' the Apr 9 memo, directs components to 'terminate or re-terminate their agreements' on or about Aug 31; carve-outs for police/security guard/firefighter local employing offices, the 90 FR 17052 subdivisions, and units covered by an operative court order. UNVERIFIED against the memo.

title_or_description: Executive Order 14251 Certification (90 FR 17052; FR Doc 2025-07054)
what_it_says: Chapter 71 can be applied to 'federal wage system employees in the trades' at (a) Letterkenny Munition Center, AMCOM, Army; (b) Air Force Test Center, AFMC; (c) Air Force Sustainment Center, AFMC; (d) Fleet Readiness Center Southeast.

title_or_description: Order Suspending the Application of Section 1-402 or 1-404 of EO 12171 (FR Doc 2025-06566)
what_it_says: Restored coverage for LIUNA; WFNHP/VASNC Local 5032 (Milwaukee VAMC); IAFF-99 (Little Rock VAMC); UNAC/UHCP (Loma Linda VAMC); Teamsters Local 115 (Coatesville VAMC); IBEW Local 2168 (Cheyenne VAMC); IAMAW Local 1998 (National Cemetery of the Pacific). Rescinded Nov 13 2025 per S01.

title_or_description: Executive Order 14251 (90 FR 14553; FR Doc 2025-05836)
what_it_says: Lists excluded agencies/subdivisions (s.1-401 to 1-419) and s.1-499 carve-outs (police/guard/firefighter local employing offices except BOP; some USMS; DoD/VA suspended subdivisions).

title_or_description: Executive Order 14343 (90 FR 42683; FR Doc 2025-16924)
what_it_says: Adds BOR hydropower units, USPTO Office of the Commissioner for Patents, NOAA NESDIS and NWS, NASA, USAGM.

title_or_description: Defense Secretary Hegseth Orders an End to DoD Collective Bargaining - IFPTE Locals are Currently Protected by Court Injunction
what_it_says: Says the DoD order 'does not currently apply to IFPTE Locals, and several other Unions' due to an injunction. GovExec 2026-04-16 says IFPTE and the Federal Education Association 'secured preliminary injunctions'. Current status not verified.

title_or_description: Appeals court seemingly OKs VA's contested union contract expiration
what_it_says: VA-AFGE master: terminated Aug 2025, reinstated by D.R.I. preliminary injunction (Judge DuBose), VA's further attempts (Mar 2026 notice S01; July 2026 announcement to let it lapse at Aug 2026 expiration) blocked by enforcement order; First Circuit stayed the latest enforcement order on Oct 2 2026. Status of the AFGE master is contested as of the as-of date.

title_or_description: Hegseth orders termination of union contracts
what_it_says: Quotes the Apr 9 2026 DoD memo (see S03); says IFPTE and the Federal Education Association 'secured preliminary injunctions blocking implementation of the executive order'; lists the four certified FWS subdivisions.

title_or_description: AFL-CIO v. Trump, No. 1:25-cv-02445-PLF, Doc 44: preliminary injunction order
source_type: court (IFPTE-hosted copy; text via OCR, page 2 checked visually)
what_it_says: Enjoins implementing EO 14251 s.2 and OPM guidance for: (1) EPA IFPTE Local 20; (2) DoD units of IFPTE Locals 1,3,4,7,8A,12,16,22,32,49,86,96,97,98,121,131,259,561,777,852,1437; AFT Overseas Federation of Teachers; Metal Trades Department councils; IOMM&P; MEBA District No. 1 Pacific Coast District; UA Local 100; IBEW Locals 26,1688,2080,2219; IAM Locals 97,174,225,282,726,1859,1998,2049,2296,2297,2424,2783,2902; (3) Coast Guard metal trades councils and IAM Local 2203; (4) DOE OPEIU Local 2001. Appeal reportedly filed Dec 2025; outcome not verified.

title_or_description: NTEU v. Trump, D.C. Cir. No. 25-5157, Rule 28(j) letter exhibit: nine 2026 agency termination notices to NTEU
source_type: court (exhibit reproduces agency notices; parts via OCR)
what_it_says: Notices terminating NTEU agreements: Treasury Departmental Offices (Ch. 297) Feb 24 2026; Bureau of the Fiscal Service (Aug 1 2019 Master Labor Agreement) Feb 25; IRS (2022 National Agreement/2025 Addendum) Feb 27; IRS Office of Chief Counsel (2025 Counsel-NTEU Agreement) Feb 27; OCC Mar 3; DOE HQ (Ch. 213 and 228) Mar 6; TTB (Dec 2022 agreement) Mar 9; EPA (Dec 26 2024 CBA) Mar 10; BLM HQ Ch. 341 (two MOUs) Apr 6 2026.

title_or_description: Message from the Director (CBA termination)
what_it_says: BOP terminates its CBA with AFGE Council of Prison Locals (CPL-33).

title_or_description: National Council of Prison Locals v. BOP, 3:25-cv-01907, preliminary injunction (Dkt 72)
what_it_says: Orders BOP to reinstate the CPL-33 master CBA and subsidiary agreements.

title_or_description: BOP re-termination memo (Exhibit to D. Conn. Dkt 79-3)
what_it_says: Re-terminates the CPL-33 master agreement; quotes OPM's Apr 25 2025 FAQ and Sept 10 2025 revised guidance.

title_or_description: Memorandum & Order on motion to enforce (Dkt 84)
what_it_says: 'The re-termination is VOID' as to the Oct 7 2026 re-termination. Nothing filed after Oct 16 2026 was reviewed.

title_or_description: AFGE Council 238 v. EPA, D. Mass. 1:26-cv-14436, Complaint
what_it_says: 'On August 8, 2025, the Agency abruptly decided, without warning, to terminate the 2024 CBA effective immediately.' (union allegation)

title_or_description: EPA becomes second federal agency to cancel its union contracts
what_it_says: Quotes EPA email: terminate contracts with 'AFGE, NAGE R4, NAGE Narragansett, [IFPTE] and NAIL'.

title_or_description: VA terminates union contracts for most bargaining-unit employees (press release)
what_it_says: Names AFGE, NAGE, NFFE, National Nurses Organizing Committee/National Nurses United, and SEIU as notified that contracts are terminated for most bargaining-unit employees.

issuer: NAAE (complaint quoting APHIS notice of Aug 12 2025)
title_or_description: NAAE v. Trump et al., D.D.C. 1:25-cv-02657, Complaint para. 30
what_it_says: APHIS notice: 'The collective bargaining agreement (CBA) between APHIS and NAAE dated August 21, 2024, and any other negotiated agreements between these parties are no longer in effect.'

title_or_description: Trump administration nixes union contracts at FEMA, USCIS, food safety agencies
what_it_says: FEMA, USCIS, FSIS and APHIS cancelled union contracts; specific FSIS agreement not named.

title_or_description: FEMA joins other federal agencies in canceling union contracts
what_it_says: FEMA acting administrator memo to AFGE Local 4060 said the CBA had been terminated.

title_or_description: Trump administration moves to end contracts with some federal employee unions
what_it_says: Aug 8 USCIS email: terminating contract with AFGE Council 119.

title_or_description: HHS latest to cancel union contracts
what_it_says: Unions 'de-recognized' within HHS OS, OGC, FDA, CDC, ASPR, NIAID, NIH and ORR; unions/units not individually listed.

title_or_description: Letter to AFGE local (JSC) on EO 14343 implementation
what_it_says: States NASA 'intends to fully implement' EO 14343 including 'termination, abrogation, or repudiation' of CBAs - intent, not a termination notice. GovExec (Mar 11 2026, S27) reports NASA had not formally terminated its IFPTE contract.

title_or_description: Energy Dept., NASA take steps to oust their unions
what_it_says: DOE notices to IFPTE, AFGE and NTEU (about Mar 10 2026, 'effective immediately'); NASA not yet formally terminated IFPTE contract.

title_or_description: Guidance on Executive Order Exclusions from Federal Labor-Management Relations Programs
what_it_says: Initial OPM implementation guidance for EO 14251.

title_or_description: FAQs for EO 14251
what_it_says: 'Agencies should not terminate any CBAs until the conclusion of litigation or further guidance from OPM directing such termination.'

title_or_description: Implementation of Executive Orders 14251 and 14343
what_it_says: Directs covered agencies to terminate or modify CBAs; agencies 'must report the status of all CBAs for every bargaining unit using the attached spreadsheet to OPM by the first of each month ... until all termination notices are executed and reported.' Spreadsheet not retrieved. Revised text excludes units under a currently-applicable court order.
